eli-docs: Heads-up: opening a focused cleanup PR for the Error Reference that groups 429, timeout, and context-limit troubleshooting. Plan: consolidate examples, replace an old embedding link, and add compact SDK retry snippets for Py + Go. Need reviewers for the snippets and wording.
sam-ops: I can review Go snippets. Do we need to explicitly state different throttling behavior for Dedicated vs Hosted?
eli-docs: Yes — add a short note in the 429 section: "throttling thresholds vary by deployment mode (Hosted/Dedicated/Private). See capacity table link." Keep it one line so it fits the table.
nina: Found a stale embedding link and an outdated curl route (v1/old-route). I'll paste corrections once PR is up.
maria: For the timeout guidance, let's add a minimal client-side retry with exponential backoff + jitter. Prefer 3 retries, per best practice.
eli-docs: Adding tiny Python snippet to include (requests):
```
# python minimal retry
for attempt in range(3):
    try:
        resp = session.post(url, json=payload, timeout=5)
        resp.raise_for_status()
        break
    except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
        time.sleep((2 ** attempt) + random.random())
```
sam-ops: I'll mirror in Go: context with timeout, 3 attempts, and backoff. I'll flag idempotency — only retry safe ops or use server-side de-dup keys.
eli-docs: Add sentence: "Only retry idempotent operations or ensure server-side deduplication (idempotency keys)."
devex-bot: Reminder: include a changelog line in the PR template and run the snippet smoke tests.
eli-docs: Will do. Also need exact error strings for the troubleshooting table (so users can match logs). Maria, can you run the Python timeout example and paste the raw exception?
maria: Running now, will post exact output.
(8m) maria: Output: "requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='api.redwood.ai', port=443): Read timed out." I'll include that verbatim in the table.
nina: Old gist id: gist.github.com/old-embed-42. New link to add: https://github.com/redwood/embeddings#best-practices. I'll add both to PR description for audit.
sam-ops: Also add a tiny note in context-trimming section showing pseudocode that trims user history before system messages and warns about semantics.
eli-docs: Good call — system messages should be last resort to trim. I'll include pseudocode and a short warning line.
deploy-bot: deploy-preview created for branch error-ref/cleanups-1965 — preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/pr/4762
eli-docs: Thanks. Reviewers: please check that Go/Python snippets compile and that the preview shows the merged troubleshooting table. If no blockers I'll merge today. :thumbsup:
maria: lgtm once CI passes.
sam-ops: lgtm with a tiny wording tweak in the Dedicated note (I'll push suggestion in PR).
nina: lgtm for links.
eli-docs: Thanks everyone — merging after CI and applying Sam's wording tweak. If you have regression prompts to add for the tests, drop them here.
